result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but two text elements are clipped: the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' list is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, and a category chip is partially visible at the right edge of the filter row (expected carousel behavior). Other than that, spacing, contrast, and layout look consistent.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off mid-glyph ('Ramen' appears as 'Rameı' / clipped) even though there is empty horizontal space to the left of the rating block; the text is truncated without an ellipsis, making the name look broken.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to use the full available width up to the rating element, and apply proper single-line truncation with an ellipsis (text-overflow: ellipsis) or wrap to two lines so the restaurant name is never clipped mid-character.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped at the right edge; while horizontal scroll affordance is expected, the card title is cut mid-word with no visual fade or peek padding to signal scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge gradient fade or consistent peek padding so the clipped card reads as scrollable content rather than a layout error.
